scenarios.criterion: A Space owns its persistent items and presented selection; temporary live tabs belong to the chosen window/Space attachment under the recorded lifecycle contract. Switching preserves page state.

Keyboard and pointer flows use the native sidebar and keep browser navigation attached to the selected Space.

scenarios.criterion: Use a documented owner-approved interval or existing project policy; do not invent a fixed timeout.

Allow pause/disable and explain an upcoming cleanup before it removes work; choose optional user-controlled cleanup over Arc's historical mandatory policy.
